s: Qeriat hattora vehammaptir ubo k' seipim: kebar nitbaer besimman ql"h shemmosheh rabbenu tiqqen lahem leyisrael sheyyihyu qorin beseper tora chamishsha gabre beyom tob, veshishsha beyom hakkippurim, vez' beshabbat, bishbil hammaala vehaqqedushsha yetera sheyyesh bekol echad al chabero — hosip bo ish echad. Veim ratzu lehosip al minyan zeh — yekolim lehosip kemo sheyyirtzu, velo hayeta hattaqqana ella kede shello yipchatu mimminyan zeh. Veyesh omerim shebbeyom tob en mosipim al Hashem, kede shello yehe shaveh im yom hakkippurim veshabbat im yiqra bo shishsha o shiba. Veken beyom hakkippurim en mosipim al shishsha, shello yehe shaveh leshabbat. Vehassebara rishona iqqar. Veap al pi ken nahagu bimdinot ellu kassebara acharona beyom hakkippurim ubekol yom tob. Millebad besimchat tora, shehakkol rotzim laalot lattora, vesomekin al sebara harishona shehi iqqar. Vegam beyom hakkippurim ubekol hayyom tob, en hammaptir mehamminyan, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Veyom tob shechal lihyot beshabbat, ledibre hakkol muttar lehosip kemo beshabbat bilbaddah. Veyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat — tob shello lehosip, mippene shessiyyume minyan haolim mekuvvanim shemmesayyemin bedibre kappara, "vekipper baado" veku', veken kullam, velaken tob shello leshannotam:

Yesh mi sheomer shello hittiru lehosip al minyan haqruim apillu beshabbat ella bizman chakme hammishna, shello hayu kol haolim lattora mebarekim, ella rishon haya mebarek beraka rishona vehaacharon haya mebarek beraka acharona, abal akshav shekkol echad mebarek bipne atzmo asur lehosip, kede shello leharbot bibrakot, dekevan shekkebar yatzeu bez' hare hashshear mebarekim beraka sheenah tzerika. Veap sheen zeh iqqar, shehare ap bizman chakme haggemara hayu nohagim kebar lebarek kol echad veechad bipne atzmo, velamma lo hizkiru zeh baggemara shenneesar lahem lehosip? Mikkol maqom tob lachush lidbarayv. Vegam mippene torach hatztzibbur rauy latztzibbur laasot taqqana shello liqrot harbeh yoter al z' hamchuyyabim:

Yesh omerim shemmuttar liqrot olim harbeh beparasha achat shechozer veqore zeh mah sheqqara zeh vechozer umebarek, veen bezeh chashash beraka lebattala, shehare bechol hammoed shel sukkot vachanukka osim ken. Umikkol maqom, en hashsheni oleh leminyan z' qeruim hamchuyyabim beshabbat ella im ken hosip od g' pesuqim shello qeraam harishon, kemo shennitbaer besimman ql"z. Veyesh omerim shellekattechilla asur lehashsheni lebarek al happesuqim shekkebar berak alehem harishon ella im ken yosip alehem g' pesuqim, veen lemedin mechol hammoed vachanukka, shei epshar beinyan acher. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu kol hashshana, lebad missimchat tora shessomekin al sebara harishona, ubemiqtzat meqomot ap beshabbat chatunna:

Hakkol olim lehitztarep leminyan z' qeruim beshabbat, apillu ishsha veqatan hayyodea lemi mebarekin, ap al pi sheenan mechuyyabim baddabar. Abal ameru chakamim ishsha lo tiqra betzibbur, mippene kebod hatztzibbur. Vaapillu qatan eno oleh ella lehitztarep laggedolim, abal lo sheyyihyu kullam qetannim o nashim, kevan sheenan mechuyyabim baddabar. Veken en haqqatan yakol lihyot maqre et haolim, dehaynu shehu yiqra beqol ram beseper tora vehaolim omerim acharayv belachash vekol hatztzibbur yotzeim yede chobatan bishmia mimmennu, hoil vehu eno mechuyyab baddabar — eno yakol lehotziam yede chobatan, ad sheyyitchayyeb kemotam, dehaynu mishsheyyabi shette searot:
Keshehaqqatan oleh lehitztarep — lo yihyeh rosho megulleh, mippene kebod hattora, vekol shekken gadol, ayyen simman b' vesimman ch' vqn"a:

Veakshav en nohagin liqrot haqqatan ella lemaptir. Veap im en kohen bebet hakkeneset ella qatan kohen — nohagim liqrot yisrael bimqom kohen. Veen bazeh issur bemah sheen choleqin kabod likhunna ap shemmin haddin kohen haqqatan yakol laalot, mikkol maqom en anu mechuyyabim kelal lekabbed kohanim qetannim, shemmitzvat aseh shel "veqiddashtam" enah ella al haggedolim, shenneemar "ki et lechem eloheka hu maqrib", vehaqqatan pasul lehaqrib:

Mamzer muttar laalot lattora, sheggam lo nittena hattora, shehare hu chayyab bekol hammitzvot haamurot battora. Veebed kenaani shello nishtachrer — dino keishsha, shehare eno chayyab ella bemitzvot shehaishsha chayyebet bahen. Veim immo yisreelit — hare zeh keyisrael gamur lekol debarayv:

Veseder haqqeruim beshabbat nitbaer besiman qal"[v]. Veen issur liqrot am haaretz shehu nikbad veashir ugedol haddor lipne talmid chakam, ki en zeh bizzayon letalmid chakam raq kabod lattora shemmitkabbedet baanashim gedolim:

Hammaptir benabi tzarik sheyyiqra battora techilla, vibarek aleha techilla vasop, veachar kak yaptir benabi, kede shello yehe kebod tora ukebod nabi shaveh im yiqra benabi lebaddo kemo sheqqareu haolim harishonim battora lebaddah:

Vehammaptir oleh leminyan z', sheim qareu battora shishsha vehammaptir hu hashshebii — day bekak. Veyesh omerim sheeno oleh leminyan z', hoil veeno qore ella bishbil kebod hattora sheyyehe odep al kebod hannabi. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, beshabbat veyom tob veyom hakkippurim sheyyekolim lehosip al hamminyan, nahagu kol yisrael middorot harishonim shehammaptir eno min hamminyan, ubazeh yotzeim ledibre hakkol, sheap lehaomerim shehu oleh leminyan, mikkol maqom hare yekolin lehosip al hamminyan. Abal bet' beab ushear taaniyyot tzibbur veyom hakkippurim bemincha, sheen yekolim lehosip al g' — hammaptir hu mehag':

Bime chakme haggemara, ap lehaomerim shehammaptir eno oleh leminyan vehaya nishlam hamminyan qodem hammaptir — lo haya hammaptir chozer veqore ezeh pesuqim mimmah sheqqara hashshebii, kemo sheanu nohagim, ella hashshebii haya meshayyer kamma pesuqim bapparasha sheyyiqraem hammaptir. Veap shehammaptir eno qoream ella bishbil kebod hattora upesuqim hahem hem chobat hayyom shechoba liqrotam hayyom — ap al pi ken yakol hammaptir liqrotam, sheap shelleinyan laalot leminyan en qeriat hammaptir nechshebet hoil veeno qore ella bishbil kebod hattora, mikkol maqom leinyan chiyyub qeriat kol happarasha — en maqpidim al kak. Veachar chibbur haggemara tiqqenu rabbanan seburae lomar qaddish achar shennishlam minyan haqqeruim qodem hammaptir, kede lehapsiq ben qeriatam liqriat hammaptir baamirat haqqaddish, lehodia shehammaptir eno min hamminyan, veim ken i epshar shehashshebii yeshayyer kamma pesuqim bapparasha lehammaptir, sheen lehapsiq beqaddish beemtza happarasha, sheadayin lo nishlema chobat hayyom, laken hinhigu sheyyigmor hashshebii o haacharon kol happarasha veyomru qaddish, vehammaptir chozer veqore g' pesuqim lepachot mimmah sheqqara kebar hashshebii o haacharon (o shear haolim). Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshabbat veyom tob veyom hakkippurim, shehammaptir eno min hamminyan, abal betisha beab, ushear taaniyyot tzibbur bemincha, veyom hakkippurim bemincha, shehammaptir hu mehamminyan — en omerim qaddish qodem hammaptir, shello lehapsiq beemtza hamminyan vegam beemtza happarasha:

Beyom shemmotziim b' separim — nohagim lehashlim hamminyan beseper rishon, vehammaptir qore bashsheni. En tzarik lomar bayyamim shesseper hashsheni eno ella mittaqqanat haggeonim, kegon bekol yom tob sheqqorin parashat hammusapin beseper b', uqeriat parasha zo eno ella mittaqqanat haggeonim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tp"ch — bevadday day bemah sheqqore otah hammaptir ap al pi sheeno qoreah ella bishbil kebod hattora. Ella apillu bayyamim sheqqeriat happarasha shebbeseper sheni hu mittaqqanat anshe keneset haggedola, kegon rosh chodesh shechal beshabbat ved' parashiyyot shebbechodesh adar — ap al pi ken yakol hammaptir liqrotah ap al pi sheeno qoreah ella bishbil kebod hattora, shehare qeriat happarasha bekol shabbat hi mittaqqanat mosheh rabbenu alayv hashshalom, veap al pi ken haya hammaptir mashlimah bime chakme haggemara:

Velama en nohagin shehaacharon mehamminyan yiqra beseper sheni vehammaptir yachazor veyiqra mah sheqqara haacharon? Lepi shello ratzu linhog likpol parasha achat ulebarek aleha b' peamim shello letzorek, kevan sheepshar lehashlim hamminyan beseper ha' vesheyyiqra hammaptir bilbaddo beseper b'. Shekkesheen motziin ella seper echad, hu sheyyesh hekreach laasot ken mechamat haqqaddish, shei epshar leomro qodem shennigmera happarasha, abal kesheqqorin b' inyanim beb' separim — omerim qaddish achar hashlamat hamminyan beseper ha' qodem qeriat hammaptir beinyan hashsheni. Vehu haddin im mosipim harbeh beseper echad — omerim haqqaddish achar hashlamat haqqeria:

Ubeyom shemmotziin g' separim, kegon rosh chodesh tebet shechal beshabbat, shetztzarik liqrot parashat hashshabua uparashat rosh chodesh veinyan shel chanukka, veken besimchat tora, shetztzarik liqrot parashat "vezot habberaka" u"bereshit" uparashat hammusapim — azay gam ken hammaptir bilbad qore baacharona umashlimin hamminyan. O apillu im mosipim al hamminyan — hakkol olim beb' separim harishonim, veacharehem omerim qaddish qodem hammaptir, lehapsiq ben qeriatam liqriat hammaptir, sheqqeriato eno ella bishbil kebod hattora. Abal qodem haqqeria beseper b' en nohagim lomar qaddish, ap im kebar nishlemu minyan haqqeruim beseper echad vehaqqore beseper b' hu nosap al hamminyan. Veyesh minhagim acherim beinyan amirat haqqaddish, ben keshemmotziim b' separim, uben keshemmotziin g', veen leshannot shum minhag. Veken im yesh maqom shennohagim keshemmotziin b' separim (berosh chodesh shechal beshabbat ubed' parashiyyot), shehaacharon mehamminyan qore bashsheni vehammaptir chozer veqore mah sheqqara haacharon — en mazchichin otam:

Qatan hayyodea lemi mebarekin — yakol laalot lemaptir. En tzarik lomar beshabbat shehammaptir eno ella chozer vekopel mah sheqqara hashshebii, ella apillu beparashat hammusapin verosh chodesh shechal beshabbat ved' parashiyyot — yakol laalot im yodea lemi mebarekin. Veap al pi shepparashat zakor hi choba min hattora sheyyishmaenna kol adam miyyisrael, vehaqqatan sheeno mechuyyab baddabar eno yakol lehotziam yede chobatan, mikkol maqom akshav hare hashsheliach tzibbur qore beqol ram umashmia latztzibbur umotziam yede chobatan:
Mi sheala liqrot battora vehalak lebet hakkeneset acher uqerauhu laalot sham, venizdammena lo otah parasha sheqqeraah kebar — tzarik lachazor ulebarek aleha techilla vasop:

Im lo nimtza bebet hakkeneset mi sheyyodea lehaptir benabi ella echad meotam shealu kebar liqrot battora, ap al pi ken kesheoleh lehaptir benabi tzarik lachazor veliqrot battora techilla mippene kebod hattora, ulebarek aleha techilla vasop, veen day bemah sheqqara kebar miqqodem. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkebar amar hashsheliach tzibbur qaddish achar hashlamat hamminyan, veachar kak noda sheen bebet hakkeneset mi sheyyodea lehaptir mibbalade otam sheqqareu kebar, vegam hashsheliach tzibbur qara kebar bibraka. Abal im noda lo ken qodem sheamar qaddish — lo yomar haqqaddish miyyad, ella hashshebii yaptir benabi, veen tzarik lachazor veliqrot battora paam b', ki day bemah sheala lashshebii, kevan shello hipsiqu adayin baamirat haqqaddish achar qeriato, veachar hahaptara ubirkoteha yomru qaddish. Veim hashshebii eno yodea lehaptir benabi — azay yomar hashsheliach tzibbur qaddish achar hashshebii, veyaaleh lehaptir hayyodea mimmi sheala liqrot battora qodem, veyachazor veyiqra battora mimmah sheqqara, vibarek techilla vasop. Abal im yesh acherim sheyyodeim lehaptir benabi — mutab sheyyaptir zeh sheadayin lo qara, veal yaptir zeh sheala kebar liqrot battora (betzibbur zeh):

Im taa hashsheliach tzibbur vesiyyem happarasha im hashshishshi veamar qaddish — en tzarik liqrot od acher lashshebii millebad hammaptir, ella yiqra im hammaptir mah sheqqara im hashshishshi veday bekak, ki haiqqar shehammaptir oleh leminyan shiba. (Abal im lo amar qaddish adayin — yiqra od shebii millebad hammaptir, kede latzet ap lehaomerim shehammaptir eno oleh leminyan z' kemo shennohagin velatzet ledibre hakkol):

Im dilleg hashsheliach tzibbur apillu teba achat vaapillu ot achat biqriat shabbat shacharit — tzarik lachazor veliqrot oto pasuq sheddilleg bo im od b' pesuqim hassemukim lo, ulebarek alehem techilla vasop im kebar berak haoleh beraka acharona. Veap im kebar siyyemu happarasha vehiptiru vehitpalelu musap — tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur o acher lachazor veliqrot hag' pesuqim shebbahem haddillug betzibbur zeh bibraka techilla vasop, kemo shennitbaer besimman ql"z, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:
